comment: T_Dubber model roster. hf_store.py resolves every entry in this order: mounted Kaggle input -> HF_HOME cache -> edge Space -> huggingface hub. Sizes are approximate, for cache planning only.

models.notes: The translation brain. Served by `vllm serve` on GPU 0; the worker passes --language-model-only and dtype half.
Default TTS engine in the Kaggle worker (omnivoice, 24 languages).
Voice-cloned TTS engine (--tts-engine qwen). Weights are vendored in mazinger/_vendor/qwen_tts for the tokenizer, but the model itself still comes from the hub.
Default transcription backend (faster-whisper / CTranslate2). Use the 'distil-large-v3' variant when VRAM is tight.
Alternative TTS engine (--tts-engine chatterbox); needs no reference transcript.
HF DATASET of ready voice profiles (abubakr, daheeh-v1, 3b1b, italian-v1, morgan-freeman, trump-v1). mazinger.profiles.fetch_profile() consumes it.

gated_notes: CohereX (Cohere Transcribe + wav2vec2) models are gated and are NOT listed by repo id here: mazinger[transcribe-coherex] resolves them internally. Set HF_TOKEN (see .env.example) before choosing --transcribe-method coherex.
